summary: Iteration 105 - Verified 2 backend bug fixes: (1) Child WO variant_selection inheritance, (2) Tax Invoice stock decrement. All 6 new tests passed + 29 regression tests from iter-99/102/103/104 passed.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_VAR_105_ prefixed items during tests, all cleaned up after each test class
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both backend fixes verified working. Child WOs now inherit parent MO's variant_selection (Fix 2). Tax Invoice creation with status='issued' decrements stock (Fix 4). Proforma→Tax Invoice conversion also decrements stock (Fix 4b).

backend.details: Created multi-level BOM (FG → SG with routing → CP with variants). Created MO for FG with variant_selection={Grit:30GT}. Verified auto-created child WO for SG has variant_selection={Grit:30GT} (was None before fix).
Started child WO for SG. Verified it consumed from CP-30GT (variant child) instead of CP (parent). CP-30GT stock dropped by 2, CP parent stock unchanged.
POST /api/crm/tax-invoices with status='issued' and qty=5. Verified item current_stock dropped from 100 to 95.
POST /api/crm/tax-invoices with status='draft' and qty=5. Verified item current_stock remained unchanged (draft invoices don't decrement stock).
Tax invoice with free-text line (no item_id). Verified no stock decrement (free-text lines are services/misc).
Created proforma with line item (stock unchanged). Converted to tax invoice. Verified stock dropped by 10 on conversion.
